# the byte-rate accessor + default.rxt data tier) and [OPT-LITSCAN] S2a
# (40 -> 41, the VM literal-run compare). Neither step touches
# 50 data rows / 7 columns: kind, selector, syntax, order, predicate,
# definition, applies -- BYTE-IDENTICAL to the 751b9c6d copy below the
# header (diffed line for line): both steps in the range are emit-side --
# pcrec definitions table (D85, docs/design/definitions_table.md). Empty field = none.
# `kind`/`selector`/`syntax` are the SAME three columns --list-syntax prints for the owning row, so the two dumps join on them.
# `order` is 1-based, dense per row (this row's Nth definitions-array entry).
# `predicate` is the option-scope tag's OWN NAME (a closed, stable vocabulary a consumer may switch on), never hand-authored prose.
# `definition` is the core-syntax TEXT for a string-kind entry, or the literal `<builder>` for an operand-taking one — never a live evaluation.
# `applies` is `active` (this entry substitutes a different construct) or `identity` (restates the row's own primitive form).
